name: AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited
summary: AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited, a Chinese enterprise established in 1965 in Chengdu, PRC, operates on a global scale. The company excels in the full lifecycle, from research and development to manufacturing, sales, maintenance, and ongoing support, of intelligent measurement and control systems for both military and civilian sectors. Its extensive portfolio encompasses sophisticated aviation defense equipment, components, parts, and accessories for civil aircraft, alongside advanced weighing control systems, various sensor instruments, and specialized aircraft instrumentation. Beyond product development and manufacturing, the company also provides aircraft production and maintenance services, and is actively involved in broad research and development initiatives. Additionally, AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited's operations extend to property management and the running of tourist hotels. The diverse array of specific products it offers includes aircraft measurement and control devices, power distribution units, hanging delivery systems, resistance strain gauges, strain sensors, weighing instruments bundled with software, smart sensors, consumer electronics, intelligent logistics equipment, industrial weighing controls, smart warehousing solutions, vehicle inspection apparatus (for both in-use and special vehicles), intelligent driving training systems, traffic information systems, ZOS management software, and solenoid valves. Formerly named Zhonghang Electronic Measuring Instruments Co.,Ltd, the company officially adopted its current identity, AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited, in January 2025. It operates as a subsidiary of the Aviation Industry Corporation of China, Ltd.
